settings.text: Every VidaLite fixture begins with a singular question: how does light shape the way we experience a room? Our collections are engineered for precision and designed for beauty — specified by architects and loved by the people who live with them.

settings.heading: Shura
settings.text: Adjustable track lighting that adapts to your vision. Each head rotates 270° horizontally and 90° vertically, delivering 3000K warm white light exactly where your design demands it. Integrated LED technology rated for 50,000+ hours of maintenance-free performance.
